memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Fatigue and mild exertional dyspnoea; Hb 9.0 g/dL, ferritin 12 ng/mL, MCV 70 fL (microcytic). Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off for men).
  - Plan: Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food; repeat Hb, ferritin, MCV in 3 months; advise iron‑rich diet (breakfast: fortified cereal with orange juice, lunch: dal with leafy greens, dinner: lean meat/legumes); review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 9.0 g/dL (Ref 13‑17)
Serum ferritin: 12 ng/mL (Ref 30‑400)
MCV: 70 fL (Ref 80‑100)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel tired most days, sometimes light‑headed when I stand up quickly. My appetite is fine, I eat regular meals.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-20 at 10:00 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (Endocrinology).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Improved energy, occasional mild tiredness; Hb 11.5 g/dL, ferritin 45 ng/mL, MCV 78 fL. Weight 77.5 kg, waist 91 cm.
  - Plan: Continue ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food; repeat labs in 3 months; maintain iron‑rich diet; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 11.5 g/dL (Ref 13‑17)
Serum ferritin: 45 ng/mL (Ref 30‑400)
MCV: 78 fL (Ref 80‑100)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Fatigue is better, I still feel a bit weary after long lectures but can manage my day.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Hb now normal at 13.2 g/dL, ferritin 110 ng/mL, MCV 85 fL. Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
  - Plan: Reduce to ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days after food; repeat labs in 3 months; continue balanced diet with iron sources; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 13.2 g/dL (Ref 13‑17)
Serum ferritin: 110 ng/mL (Ref 30‑400)
MCV: 85 fL (Ref 80‑100)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel much better, no more dizziness. Taking tablets every other day is easy to remember.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Slight drop in Hb to 12.0 g/dL, ferritin 80 ng/mL, MCV 82 fL; weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90).
  - Plan: Restart ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food; repeat labs in 3 months; reinforce iron‑rich meals, especially breakfast with vitamin C; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 12.0 g/dL (Ref 13‑17)
Serum ferritin: 80 ng/mL (Ref 30‑400)
MCV: 82 fL (Ref 80‑100)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling a bit more tired lately, especially after skipping breakfast. I’ll try to eat more regularly.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Hb 13.5 g/dL, ferritin 130 ng/mL, MCV 88 fL; weight 77.5 kg, waist 90 cm.
  - Plan: Continue ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food; labs stable, will check again in 6 months; maintain diet; review in 6 months.
